amendment_boundary: before any live controller cell was run, canonical input decks were relocated to tracked fixtures, geometric canvas coverage and termination invariants were hardened in the production harness, and TaskContract became single semantic truth. Runtime hashes were refreshed prospectively; paired tasks, policies, caps, outcomes, and statistics are unchanged.
research_question: At a fixed model and budget, does CEGAR-H improve real PPT artifact success or reduce verification cost at matched success?
null_hypothesis: CEGAR-H has no paired success or verification-cost advantage over direct, always-verify, or evidence-only.

policies.direct: fixed 25-step generation baseline; no mutation after terminal verification begins
policies.always_verify: fixed 25-step generation cap; require fresh structural, render, and pixel evidence between material mutations
policies.evidence_only: fixed 25-step generation cap; allow direct and evidence meta-actions but prohibit compute and joint meta-actions
policies.cegar_h: adaptive generation compute up to 50 steps; allow direct, evidence, compute, and joint meta-actions; invalidate certificates after mutation

predefined_outcomes.artifact_success: PPTX opens; required text and slide bounds pass; PDF and every slide PNG exist; no unintended overlap, overflow, unresolved placeholder, or stale post-mutation evidence
predefined_outcomes.verification_count: number of covered structural, render, and pixel verification invocations

statistics.uncertainty: paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval over tasks
statistics.cost_test: paired permutation test conditional on equal artifact success
statistics.missing_cell_rule: exclude the entire task from paired inference and report the infrastructure-invalid cell; never impute

claim_boundary: Protocol readiness is not causal evidence; all 48 cells and preregistered paired statistics are required.
